CLM-MAT-0209.statement: The estimated superconducting transition temperature for unstrained monolayer CsTi3Bi5 is 2.6 K.

evidence_spans: Solving the anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg equations at different temperatures gives the temperature dependence of ∆ nk, from which we estimateT C = 3.2 K, close to theT C estimated by the Allen-Dynes modified McMillan equation.
Solving the anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg equations at different temperatures

Solving the anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg equations at different temperatures gives the temperature dependence of ∆ nk, from which we estimateT C = 3.2 K, close to theT C estimated by the Allen-Dynes modified McMillan equation.
CLM-MAT-0210.statement: Under optimal tensile strain of +2%, the superconducting transition temperature estimated from the temperature dependence of the gap is 3.2 K.

extra_quotes: The first-principles calculations based on density functional theory were performed using the Quantum ESPRESSO package [21, 22].
The superconducting gaps were calculated using the EPW code [26].
